14197.html:
14197 akṣōṭa [Poss. ext. of akṣa- (akṣa-² 'seed of Elaeocarpus ganitrus') with suffix -ṭa- (as in śarkōṭá- 'scorpion' AV. Wackernagel-Debrunner Suffixes 514) beside Ir. *axša-ra- in Oss. äxsärä H. W. Bailey BSOAS 20, 58. NIA. forms with -r- may then be < *akṣarōṭṭa- (cf. dimin. suffix -uṭṭa- in WPah. (e.g. Varma BhalDial 23). M. akroḍ (~ akroṭ) is X akhoḍ rather than < *akṣarōṭṭa-]
    agāra-: *pānīyāgāraka-.
